verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted inference engine, so asking whether it offers an isolated test or sandbox mode is a fair question. The evidence pack documents serving, batching, quantization, tool calling, Docker deployment and benchmarking. None of it describes a sandbox environment, test mode, or separation from production data. Being able to run separate instances yourself is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
